text:
Colliers, a leading diversified professional services and investment management company, announced the $23.15 million sale of the Coolidge Corner Collection in Brookline, Massachusetts. On behalf of Ramon Realty, the sale was facilitated by a Colliers team including Managing Director of Investment Sales Frank Petz, Senior Vice President Tim McGeary, Vice President Brett Curtis, Senior Financial Analyst Matt Lombardi.
The nine-building, mixed-use portfolio includes properties at 223 and 229-231 St. Paul Street, 26-28 Browne Street, 395-397 Harvard Street, 7 Naples Road and 1343 Beacon Street. Including 49 residential units and three commercial spaces, the portfolio totals 65,262 square feet and was acquired by City Realty. The location was a significant driver in interest for the property, being in one of Brookline’s most desirable neighborhoods and adjacent to top medical and academic institutions.
The offering attracted strong interest from local, regional and national investors despite uncertainty surrounding the proposed statewide rent-control ballot initiative, highlighting continued demand for well-located, supply-constrained Greater Boston multifamily assets.
The portfolio offered a compelling value-add opportunity alongside strong 96% occupancy. Only 12% of units had been fully renovated and 57% partially upgraded, leaving meaningful upside for new ownership to renovate units as leases expire and drive additional value.
“The Coolidge Corner Collection represents the type of high-quality multifamily asset that will continue to attract investors,” Frank Petz, Managing Director of Investment Sales at Colliers, said. “The depth of interest we saw throughout the process, despite uncertainty surrounding the proposed rent-control ballot initiative, speaks to investors’ conviction in Brookline and the opportunity for the portfolio to create additional value through continued unit improvements.”
The sale follows the recent expansion of Colliers’ multifamily platform in Boston with the additional hires of McGeary and Curtis in July. With deep expertise in multifamily investment advisory, the hires enhance Colliers’ multifamily capabilities across Greater Boston while further strengthening the connection between the firm’s Boston Capital Markets platform and its national multifamily business.
Colliers is a global diversified professional services and investment management company operating through three industry-leading businesses: Commercial Real Estate, Engineering, and Investment Management. With greater than a 30-year track record of consistent growth and strong recurring cash flows, we scale complementary, high-value businesses that provide essential services across the full asset lifecycle. Our unique partnership philosophy empowers exceptional leaders, preserves our entrepreneurial culture, and ensures meaningful inside ownership — driving strong alignment and sustained value creation for our shareholders. With $5.7 billion in annual revenues, 24,000 professionals, and $109 billion in assets under management, Colliers is committed to accelerating the success of our clients, investors, and people worldwide.
